prompt:
EXACT OPEN SIDES: NW. CLOSED SIDES: NE, SW, SE. Closed sides have continuous solid back walls or uninterrupted low foreground rails; NO other openings, aprons, floor tongues or doorway-like recesses. Do not copy the extra doors of Image 1. Exactly 1 open threshold(s).
GEOMETRY FIRST: exact native 1672x941 RGB landscape. Main floor diamond (185,480),(835,155),(1485,480),(835,805), opposing edges parallel at 2:1 slope 26.6 degrees. NW apron corners (446,350),(311,282),(515,180),(650,248). COMPLETE drawn floor polygon INCLUDING apron tips: (185,480),(446,350),(311,282),(515,180),(650,248),(835,155),(1485,480),(835,805). Main floor at least 5% inside every canvas border, complete floor including apron tips at least 4%. Preserve broad floor at least 850x450px and at least 25% of the canvas. NW is the ONLY open framed doorway, width about260px; apron continues diagonally up-left, far edge (311,282)-(515,180) diagonal, not vertical pocket. NE back wall and both SW/SE foreground rails CLOSED with no gaps, extra door recesses or floor tongues. NW apron is neutral grey, saturation <=0.10, no amber reflection or bright coloured puddle.
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new finished opaque RGB room plate S10_O01, O01_VAULT. Image 1 is only fixed camera, scale, neutral standard deck, minimum floor size and doorway dimensions. Image 2 is only premium hard-surface material quality; ignore its actors, markings and UI.
Premium 2.5D tactical sci-fi game environment plate for SABLE CIRCUIT, underground research facility SITE-7.
CAMERA: fixed near-orthographic three-quarter top-down dimetric view. Floor panel seams and wall bases run at exactly a 2:1 slope (26.6 degrees from horizontal) in both diagonal directions. No perspective convergence, no fisheye, no tilted horizon.
SCALE: a standing adult would be about 1/12 of the image width tall. Square floor panels about one adult-height wide; waist-high railings; door frames about 1.6 adult-heights tall.
FLOOR: one clean, open, flat SITE-7 standard deck of dark gunmetal steel plates with fine seams and light wear, bounded by a wall base or a low raised lip. The floor is uncluttered: no text, no markings with letters or numbers, no objects in the open floor.
LIGHT: even neutral-white overhead industrial light (about 6000K) across the entire walkable floor. No hot spots, no pitch-black patches, no vignette, no darkened corners, no fog or haze over the floor. The floor stays neutral grey steel and is never tinted by room colour.
COLOUR IDENTITY: only on walls, machinery, fixtures and small practical lamps along the perimeter; their light spill on the floor is subtle and never reaches within one adult-height of a doorway.
OUTSIDE: everything beyond the architecture is flat near-black void (#07090D) with no gradient.
EXCLUDE: characters, creatures, robots, weapons, UI, HUD, text, signage, numbers, logos, projectiles, explosions, smoke over the floor, translucent or doubled geometry, black borders or frames.
STYLE: premium stylized realism with hard-surface wall thickness, recessed panels, structural supports and cast contact shadows. Not low-poly, not flat vector, not generic neon cyberpunk, not blurry concept art.
ROOM PLATE. The walkable floor is a dimetric diamond or elongated hexagon whose sides face NW (upper-left), NE (upper-right), SE (lower-right) and SW (lower-left). Back walls rise only along the NW and NE sides; the SW and SE sides end in a low lip or railing with no wall so nothing hides the floor. Keep main floor at least5% from borders, whole floor including apron tips at least4%.
DOORS: open doorways exactly on these sides: NW. Each doorway is an unobstructed opening about 2.3 adult-heights wide with a heavy steel frame (a framed opening in a back wall, or a gap in the lip railing on the SW/SE side); no door leaf, no shutter. The same standard deck and the same neutral-white overhead light continue through every doorway for about 1.5 adult-heights on both sides of the threshold.
ROOM TYPE: non-combat room — walkable floor at least 850 x 450 (long x short, in the scale above).
IDENTITY: sealed reserve vault: armoured storage lockers and heavy supply cases along the walls. Accent colour amber, on walls and fixtures only.
Exactly 1 usable opening(s), only NW. All other sides (NE, SW, SE) are continuous closed walls or continuous low foreground railings: no rail gaps, floor tongues, passages, apparent doorway recesses or shutters there.
CRITICAL NEW WALL SILHOUETTE: redraw the wall architecture and machinery from the IDENTITY above; do not copy Image 1 wall masses, fans, consoles or machine arrangement. This room must differ from other operation-10 rooms and all earlier operation plates. Black alloy and red seams stay on the WALL architecture; include a few distinct small practical wall lamps in the required accent, with visible lamp cores and a restrained local wall glow. No lettering-like floor patterns, red light bloom, black floor or coloured floor. The floor is standard neutral gunmetal grey, mean sRGB luminance 0.17-0.24; doorway apron saturation at most 0.10. The exposed outside remains uniform #07090D.
Door apron outer edges are oblique and parallel to the attached deck; no vertical-cut pocket. Main floor must remain at least5%, whole floor including apron tips at least4%, inside each image border. Floor material and light are neutral, with no red wash or black alloy on the deck. Several clear perimeter lamp cores illuminate the wall only.
WALL CONTENT CRITERION: the shared map-kit corner/end columns, wall bays, door gap and door-flanking columns may match Image 1. The equipment and panel configuration INSIDE each bay must be new and specific to this IDENTITY, different from the same-slot S3 plate and the other operation-10 plates. Do not reproduce the reference bay contents with only recolouring.
SPECIFIC NEW BAY CONTENT: sealed RESERVE VAULT. Broad black-alloy ARMOURED STORAGE LOCKERS with large horizontal double-panel doors, recessed crossbar locking bars and thick smooth beveled shield faces. Heavy wide SUPPLY CASES in two-tier shallow wall-mounted cradles, flush to the back walls and never in the walking floor. In each bay use two broad horizontal locker blocks rather than rows of narrow vertical wired cartridges or little shelf canisters in S3_O01. No S3_O01 repeated narrow circuit-cabinet doors, exposed cable matrices, packed small canister racks. No lift guide-rail cage from R06, record cartridges from R03, relay obelisks from R02 or monolith from R05. Common corner/end posts and door framing may remain. Distinct amber wall lamp cores with confined amber glow on black wall plates, no amber floor. Thin red wall seam allowed only on walls. NW single opening; other sides shut. Middle completely empty.
